name: Ludentia
tagline: Enterprise-grade performance coaching for competitive players.
positioning: Ludentia pairs ranked players with vetted coaches and turns every scrim, VOD, and ranked session into a structured, measurable improvement program.

hero.h1: Coaching operations for players who intend to climb.
hero.sub: Ludentia standardizes how you practice: matched coaches, scheduled VOD reviews, and a performance ledger that quantifies your progress rank by rank.

features.title: Verified coach roster
features.description: Every coach is credentialed against peak rank, teaching track record, and title-specific curriculum before they appear in your matches.

features.title: Structured VOD review
features.description: Upload a match and receive a timestamped breakdown of positioning, macro decisions, and mechanical errors within 24 hours.

features.title: Performance ledger
features.description: Track win rate, KDA trend, and objective control across sessions in one dashboard built for measurable improvement.

features.title: Session scheduling
features.description: Book recurring blocks that sync to your queue times, with automated reminders and rescheduling for coach and player.

features.title: Ranked-goal roadmaps
features.description: Set a target rank and receive a milestone plan with weekly focus areas, drills, and accountability checkpoints.

features.title: Cross-title support
features.description: One account covers League, Valorant, Counter-Strike, and Rocket League with curriculum tuned per title.

testimonials.quote: We moved our entire academy pipeline onto Ludentia. The performance ledger gave our staff a defensible way to justify promotions instead of relying on vibes.
testimonials.name: Mateus Ferreira

testimonials.quote: I climbed from Diamond to Grandmaster in one split. The 24-hour VOD turnaround meant I fixed macro mistakes before they became habits.
testimonials.name: Hana Okafor

testimonials.quote: Coach vetting was the selling point. Every session felt structured, and the milestone roadmap kept our roster aligned during a brutal qualifier run.
testimonials.name: Devin Castellano

pricing.blurb: For individual players building a consistent practice routine.
For serious climbers pursuing a specific rank target.
For teams and academies managing multiple players.

homepage.footerBlurb: Ludentia is the operating system for competitive improvement — verified coaches, structured review, and measurable progress in one platform.
